channel.title: Removal Queue Updates
channel.description: Updates for installed Removal Queue plug-ins.

item.title: Removal Queue 0.5.3 Preview
item.description:
Removal Queue 0.5.3 Preview introduces the Clean Sweep icon.
- A clay-and-cream eraser gives Removal Queue its own identity alongside Sam's other photography tools. - The eraser appears in the floating window while no photos are marked. The photo count replaces it when marks are tracked; processing progress remains visible as before. - The Mac companion, update window, and Lightroom Plug-in Manager use the new icon.
Includes the direct processing, Smart Preview support, faster marked-photo scan, review collections, and Clear Queue controls from 0.5.2. This remains a preview release; the outstanding native acceptance checks are documented in the project.
